# netbox_vlan_translation_rules (Data Source)

Retrieves all vlan translation rules from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vlan_translation_rules" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "created"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "vlan_translation_rules_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_vlan_translation_rules.example.vlan_translation_rules[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vlan_translation_rules` (Attributes List) The vlan translation rules found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlan_translation_rules))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--vlan_translation_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlan_translation_rules`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) A description of the vlan translation rules.
- `id` (Number) The id of the vlan translation rules.
- `last_updated` (String) When the vlan translation rules was last changed.
- `local_vid` (Number) The local vid of the vlan translation rules.
- `policy` (Number) The policy of the vlan translation rules.
- `remote_vid` (Number) The remote vid of the vlan translation rules.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
